display.purpose: Hero H1, vision captions, choice-panel headline. Serif sanctuary — never below 24px, never in UI controls.

headline.purpose: Choice-panel ritual title. The only second place Georgia is allowed.

title.purpose: Section heads (背包/任务/日志). Sans, 800 weight, paired with gold icon.

body.purpose: All paragraph copy, dialogue, log entries. Chinese-first stack mandatory.

label.purpose: Field labels, brand-mark, HUD pill contents. Only permitted micro-uppercase context.

numeric.purpose: All HUD / stat / strength / gold numeric readouts. tabular-nums mandatory.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default panel / card. Mid-depth lift with inset top reflection.

shadows.name: hovering
shadows.purpose: Play-area, disi-avatar resting. HUD floating above Phaser canvas.

shadows.name: imposing
shadows.purpose: Dialogue panel, choice panel, primary-action. Critical interactions that must stop the player.

shadows.name: dramatic
shadows.purpose: Vision-frame, creation-panel ritual moments. Ceremony tier.

shadows.name: stage-pulse
shadows.purpose: Disi avatar stage-3 only. Pulses to indicate vessel consumption. Reduced-motion fallback required.

motion.name: ease-tactile
motion.purpose: Default 160ms button state / hover transitions. Exponential ease-out, no bounce.

motion.name: duration-modal
motion.purpose: Disi-avatar border-color & box-shadow on stage shift.

motion.name: stage-pulse-cycle
motion.purpose: disi-pulse keyframe. Requires reduced-motion crossfade fallback.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one-per-screen unrecoverable commit. Gold gradient fill, dark text, dramatic shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(236,197,103,0.54); border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d2aa51, #9c6e2f); color: #141008; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(122,83,29,0.28); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), background 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e3bd62, #a87934); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(122,83,29,0.34); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217,182,98,0.72); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Selectable option in segmented controls, appearance grid, choice list. Dark bg, gold hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(225,211,168,0.18); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(18,22,23,0.92); color: #f2ead8; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms, background 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(36,41,40,0.96); border-color: rgba(225,197,125,0.36); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217,182,98,0.72); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary.is-selected { border-color: rgba(217,182,98,0.86); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(83,64,34,0.98), rgba(42,35,25,0.98)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,232,171,0.08); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Character name and form fields. Inset chiseled feel with gold focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(220,202,150,0.3); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(7,9,10,0.94); color: #f2ead8; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transition: border-color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #d9b662; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217,182,98,0.11), inset 0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #b3aa98; }

components.name: Panel Section
components.description: Side-panel cards (character / inventory / quest / log). Tunnel-Black gradient with faint gold weave and gold-line border.
components.html:
背包

矿袋空着，只剩黑潮和铁锈的气味。
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(206,181,116,0.18); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17,20,21,0.94), rgba(10,12,13,0.94)), repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(217,182,98,0.025) 0, rgba(217,182,98,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 18px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.035), 0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); color: #f2ead8; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #d9b662; } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-panel-empty { margin: 0; color: #b3aa98; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: HUD Pill
components.description: Floating HUD readout (污染/觉醒/金币). Backdrop-blurred metal nameplate hovering over Phaser canvas.
components.html: 污染 42
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(231,214,165,0.18); border-radius: 7px; background: rgba(8,10,11,0.76); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: #f2ead8; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); }

components.name: Dialogue Panel
components.description: In-world speech panel. Whisper variant for Khah uses violet border + pixelated portrait.
components.html:
克哈低语

血没有溅到你身上，它像认识你一样避开了。
components.css: .ds-dialogue { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 18px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(217,182,98,0.24); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,14,15,0.92), rgba(6,8,9,0.94)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.42), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #f2ead8; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialogue.is-whisper { border-color: rgba(144,80,163,0.46); } .ds-dialogue-portrait { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(155,86,166,0.5); image-rendering: pixelated; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(95,36,119,0.42); } .ds-dialogue-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; } .ds-dialogue-body strong { color: #d9b662; font-weight: 800; } .ds-dialogue-body p { margin: 6px 0 0; line-height: 1.65; text-wrap: pretty; max-width: 68rem; } .ds-dialogue-close { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(24,28,29,0.92); color: #e8dcc2; cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; }

components.name: Inventory Item Row
components.description: Loot row with quality-tinted full border (replacement for the banned side-stripe inset shadow). Quality color carries via icon + integrated border, not as a left stripe.
components.css: .ds-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 58px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(225,211,168,0.18); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(16,20,22,0.92); color: #f2ead8; font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-item:hover { background: rgba(28,33,34,0.96); transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-item-icon { flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(8,10,11,0.6); } .ds-item-meta { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; } .ds-item-meta strong { display: block; color: #f3e4bd; font-weight: 700; } .ds-item-meta small { display: block; color: #a9a08f; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-item em { max-width: 42%; text-align: right; color: #a9a08f; font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; } .ds-item--rare { border-color: rgba(115,154,214,0.68); } .ds-item--rare .ds-item-icon { background: rgba(115,154,214,0.16); } .ds-item--corrupted { border-color: rgba(155,86,166,0.72); } .ds-item--corrupted .ds-item-icon { background: rgba(155,86,166,0.18); } .ds-item--relic { border-color: rgba(218,169,73,0.76); } .ds-item--relic .ds-item-icon { background: rgba(218,169,73,0.18); }

narrative.overview: 界面是玩家容器觉醒的门槛。系统当下的语调是冷峻矮人金属：黑铁载体上点状金光、锐边、薄阴影里的重量感。但门槛是双向的——随着污染（worldState.corruption）和容器觉醒（worldState.vesselAwakening）攀升，UI 的色相和能量应当能向克哈的紫和黑潮的血推进。整套系统拒绝四种东西：迷你传三型手游面板、Roblox 卡通调、AAA 设置菜单的全灰冷青、Notion/Linear 的 SaaS 净色。
keyCharacteristics: 黑铁载体（#080a0b 全屏底）+ 点状金光（#d9b662 ≤15% 屏占）+ 偶发紫红（仅在污染相关上下文）
三轴并列人格：潮湿腐烂 × 冷峻工业矮人机械 × 不可信梦境
衬线（Georgia）只在文学时刻：H1、Choice 标题、Vision caption
Material-dramatic elevation：modal 与 vision 走 22-90px 厚阴影
中文是基线，英文是充气符；font-stack 头部永远是中文家族

rules.name: The 15% Lantern Rule
rules.body: Miner's Lantern Gold 在任何屏幕上的色块占比 ≤ 15%。超过这条线矿灯就不再是光源，变成装饰品。

rules.name: The Violet Permission Rule
rules.body: Khah's Whisper Violet 只在污染语义（觉醒第 2-3 阶、感染、低语对话、堕落装备、幻象）出现。永远不要当中性强调色用。

rules.name: The Soot Ceiling Rule
rules.body: #7f786b (Soot Gray) 是天花板不是地板，约 3.6:1，仅用于装饰性次级标签。一旦超过 14px 或承载可读信息，必须升级到 Tunnel Mist 或 Lantern Cream。

rules.name: The Serif-Sanctuary Rule
rules.body: Georgia 只允许在 H1 / Headline / Vision caption / Choice 标题。任何 button/label/HUD/≤16px 位置出现衬线都是错的。

rules.name: The Chinese-First Stack Rule
rules.body: 所有 font-family 栈的首位必须是中文家族。引入任何 web font 之前先确认中文字形完整或显式 fallback。

rules.name: The Tabular Numeric Rule
rules.body: 任何 HUD / stat-grid / 强度 / 金币 数值必须 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums。数字跳动 = 体验未完成。

rules.name: The Lit-from-Above Rule
rules.body: 任何卡片/面板/按钮的 inset highlight 永远在顶部，模拟矿灯反光。其他方向是错的。

rules.name: The Backdrop-Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur 只允许在悬浮于 Phaser 之上的 UI (HUD/dialogue/choice/vision)。在全屏 UI 上用 backdrop-blur 是 Notion/Linear SaaS 玻璃风，PRODUCT.md 已拒绝。

rules.name: The No-Mid-Shadow Rule
rules.body: SaaS 风格 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 在矿黑底色上完全看不见，等于没写。要么 Resting (12px+)，要么不要 shadow。

dos: Do verify every body text and label hits ≥ 4.5:1 against #080a0b. Lantern Cream 和 Tunnel Mist 安全，Soot Gray 是装饰天花板。
Do 在所有 font-family 栈的首位放中文家族（Microsoft YaHei / PingFang SC / Noto Sans SC）。English 是 fallback、不是 base。
Do 用 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 包住所有 HUD / stat-grid / 强度 数值。
Do 给每条新动画写 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) 替代方案。当前 disi-pulse 缺这一条，是技术债。
Do 用 Imposing/Dramatic shadow tier 强调仪式时刻（modal、choice、vision），让玩家停下来。
Do 用 Khah's Whisper Violet 仅在污染语义触发时（觉醒第 2-3 阶、感染、低语对话、堕落装备、幻象）。
Do 用 text-wrap: balance 包所有 h1-h3；text-wrap: pretty 包长 prose。
donts: Don't 在按钮、标签、表格、≤16px 任何文字上用 Georgia 衬线。Serif-Sanctuary Rule 死守。
Don't 让 Miner's Lantern Gold 超过一屏 15% 屏占。超过这条线，矿灯变装饰品。
Don't 在 .panel-section 或 .creation-panel 这类全屏 UI 用 backdrop-filter: blur。Backdrop-blur 只属于悬浮于 Phaser 之上的 HUD/dialogue/choice/vision。
Don't 使用 side-stripe border（border-left/right > 1px 或 inset Npx 0 0 color）作为分类着色。当前 item-row.rare/.corrupted/.relic 是这一禁令的违反，待重构：整圈彩色 border + 左侧 quality icon。
Don't 使用 24px+ 圆角。当前最大 12px（vision-frame），任何超过都是卡通调。
Don't 写 border: 1px solid + box-shadow ≥ 16px 在同一按钮 — ghost-card 通用 ban。Panel 例外（必须有 shadow），按钮只能二选一。
Don't 使用渐变文字（background-clip: text + gradient）。Miner's Lantern Gold 是单色 token。
Don't 引入小写 ALL-CAPS tracked eyebrow（ABOUT / 01·）在每个 section 顶部。brand-mark 是合法的单一品牌 kicker，不要扩展。
Don't 写 X剧场 / 不只是 X / 真正的 X 这类 marketing-meta 文案。
Don't 在 SaaS 风格 0 1px 2px shadow 上浪费时间。No-Mid-Shadow Rule。
Don't 使用迷你传三 / Roblox 卡通 / AAA 全灰 / Notion SaaS 任何一种调子。
